facts.text: Dad wants proof I can run the hotels, so I packed my own school lunch. Ham sandwich, chips and a pudding cup.
facts.why: Invented line signed Billy Madison. The only school lunch bit he says is to a kid with a chocolate pudding: 'I bet that snack pack is pretty good huh?'
facts.fix: I bet that snack pack is pretty good huh?

fix_note.text: I bet that snack pack is pretty good huh?

facts.text: Billy's poolside order, before O'Doyle rules.
facts.why: No prawn cocktail or poolside order is in the film. Billy is by the pool and the penguin shows up before school starts and the O'Doyle chant begins.
facts.fix: A poolside starter, before O'Doyle rules.

vibe.verdict: The hotel front desk idea fits the setup, but the school lunch gags (pudding snack pack, Sloppy Joes) and O'Doyle are barely there.
missing: O'Doyle rules! (12th grade locker, and the O'Doyle family ending)
Extra sloppy Sloppy Joes from the lunch lady (school cafeteria)
The chocolate pudding snack pack and the banana trade (first grade)
'Shampoo is better; I go on first' (Billy's bath)
The bus driver eating the kids' stolen bagged lunches
ideas: Swap 'Madison Hotel mini club sandwiches' for 'Extra sloppy Sloppy Joes' (lunch lady).
Swap 'Prawn cocktail, Marie Rose sauce' for 'Snack pack chocolate pudding and a banana to trade.'
Swap the Arnold Palmer note for 'O'Doyle rules!' on the bill.
Swap 'Pool party chilli cheese dogs' for fish sticks 'for Mr. Penguin'.
